text:
Looking at this question: "total revenue by location" — "revenue" is governed by term:Revenue, but that term distinguishes gross order revenue (order_total, includes tax) from product revenue (excludes tax) — two competing definitions with no qualifier to disambiguate, and location is only available on the orders/locations model, so this is material.
